info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Customer Information API
info.description: The Update Customer Information API enables businesses to modify existing customer details within their system. It provides a streamlined way to manage customer profiles, ensuring that information remains current and accurate. Typical consumers of this API include customer support representatives and account managers who handle customer data updates. Operations involve adjusting various attributes related to a specific customer using their unique identifier, thus facilitating effective customer relationship management.
